# AnalyzeG — Full Platform Documentation

## What is AnalyzeG?
AnalyzeG provides screened 30-second in-hand product videos for consumer brands in India, with human moderation, Power BI dashboards, competitor context, and gated raw CSV/Excel exports. Eligible reviewers receive compensation under the category terms shown in their account.

Brand owned and operated by Souvik Dey, Udyam MSME Registered, West Bengal, India. Data Fiduciary for DPDP Act 2023 purposes. Grievance: grievance@analyzeg.co.in. Founded 2024.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Brands
1. Register your brand on AnalyzeG (app.analyzeg.co.in/b2b-auth)
2. Request a scoped quote (projects starting at ₹5L) — one-time dataset licensing, GST invoice, PO accepted, DPA on request. Final quote confirmed in writing before collection.
3. Specify target demographics: state, age, gender
4. Receive 30-second in-hand product videos — face-presence verified via 5-point checks (face-presence, device, geo, content, timestamp) + human moderation, time-stamped with audit logs
5. Access Power BI dashboard with sentiment & keyword themes, competitor benchmarking, state/age/gender filters
6. Download raw CSV/Excel with video links for independent verification
7. Use an own-product video for defined marketing purposes only where the reviewer has opted in; competitor videos are research evidence, not advertising assets.
Delivery: in-stock datasets in minutes; custom quotas per agreed SLA confirmed in writing before collection.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Reviewers
1. Sign up via For Reviewers (analyzeg.co.in/for-reviewers) and complete profile
2. Choose categories with active brand demand (Categories Needed Now)
3. Record authentic 30-second in-hand video per checklist (face in frame, product in hand, genuine voice)
4. Submit for 5-point face-presence verification + human moderation
5. Receive a paid advance after verification (in bounty categories) — then on each brand purchase, receive a revenue share per sale. Exact rates are shown inside your reviewer account after login.
6. Payout via UPI or bank within 24h of each sale event. T&C apply.

Payment: No fee to join, no followers needed. Separate consent for ad licensing at submission.

## Pricing for Brands
- Projects starting at ₹5L (one-time dataset licensing, no subscription). Final quote depends on volume, categories, filters and timeline.
- Every project: Power BI dashboard + template, raw CSV/Excel with video links (gated access), state/age/gender filters, sentiment & trend analysis, video ad licensing (own-product, where reviewers opt in).

## Analytics Features
- Sentiment analysis from video + survey responses
- Keyword trend detection across datasets
- Competitor benchmarking
- Demographic segmentation by state, age, gender
- Custom Power BI dashboard templates
- Raw export (CSV/Excel) with video links
- Role-based access, time-bound video links, licence controls, and audit logs

## Technology & Verification
- Five screening checks: face-presence, device integrity, geo-consistency, content checklist, and timestamp, followed by human moderation
- Face-presence confirms that a face appears in the video; it does not independently prove identity or product ownership
- Time-stamped review records and audit logs

## FAQ — Brands
Q: How does verification work? A: 5-point face-presence + human moderation before sellable pool.
Q: How quickly? A: In-stock datasets in minutes; custom quotas per agreed SLA.
Q: Can we use videos as ads? A: Yes for own-product videos (license included, where reviewers opt in); competitor videos are insights-only.
Q: Data protection? A: Role-based access, time-bound video links, licence controls, audit logs, and data-handling practices designed to support applicable data-protection requirements. Current terms are provided in the Privacy Notice and DPA pack.

## FAQ — Reviewers
Q: How much can I earn? A: Paid advance after verification (bounty categories) + revenue share per brand sale, multiple sales = multiple payouts. Exact rates inside your reviewer account.
Q: When paid? A: Advance after verification (bounty categories). Balance within 24h of each brand purchase.
Q: Equipment? A: Smartphone + stable internet.

## Values
- Integrity: Every review is screened and moderated, with limitations stated
- Innovation: Analytics turns raw video into decision-ready intelligence
- Fairness: Transparent dual-stage payout linked to quality, not rating
- Transparency: Raw data to verify every insight
